executive_summary: On May 21, 2026, OFAC removed one individual from the SDN list. The removed individual, Albanese Francesca Paola, was previously sanctioned under the ICC-EO14203 program. No additions or updates were made to the list.

risk_implications.description: The removal of Albanese Francesca Paola from the SDN list may indicate a reduced risk of sanctions exposure in Tunisia.

program_highlights.note: One individual was removed from this program.

compliance_recommendations: Review and update internal watchlists to reflect the removal of Albanese Francesca Paola from the SDN list.
